correctness.rationale: The 21 common-open-neighborhoods have ten vertices each. Independent face enumeration reproduced 18,494 nonempty faces, f-vector (21,210,1190,3780,5187,4410,2520,945,210,21), and reduced mod-two Betti ranks 246 (dimension 3) and 7 (dimension 4). The assigned verify.py (Git blob 9a7e6d63...) specifies a complete 9,120-pair directed-Hasse acyclicity test on 98,805 incidences, one critical vertex and 246 degree-3 plus seven degree-4 cells; its exact signed integral gradient projection checks all seven four-to-three boundary columns zero. That yields the wedge by Hurewicz since pi3(wedge S3) is Z^246. The same theorem and integral proof are also explicitly provided in the earlier published full-text result. Independent mod-two computation alone would not prove integral homotopy, so the critical integral argument was inspected in the actual code and published proof.
residual_risks: The signed Morse certificate is read rather than independently run in full; an implementation defect could affect its absolute correctness, although earlier identical integral proof corroborates it. No assertion for other T_n, equivariance, or closed neighborhoods.
